descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer with a strong background in building and optimizing data pipelines and large-scale data processing solutions. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape data strategies, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient and reliable data delivery.
 What you will do: 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and architectures for batch and streaming processing.
Implement complex SQL queries and optimize database performance.
Build and automate custom data processing solutions using Python.
Work with Apache Spark and Apache Kafka for distributed data processing.
Orchestrate data workflows using Apache Airflow.
Develop data transformation processes with DBT.
Ensure efficient version control and CI/CD using GitLab.
Work with Docker and Kubernetes for deployment and containerization.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and high-quality data solutions.
Support business continuity through effective monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of data pipelines.
Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to the team.
 What you need to have: 
Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale data solutions.
Strong expertise in SQL (including complex queries).
Proficiency in Python for data engineering tasks and automation.
Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Apache Kafka.
In-depth knowledge of Apache Airflow for orchestration.
Experience with DBT for data transformation.
Proficiency with GitLab for version control and CI/CD.
Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Shell scripting skills (e.g., Bash).
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle large, complex datasets.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Proven ability to mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership.
 Nice to have: 
Hands-on experience with AWS (or another cloud provider).
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
